title: Regularized paired-view CCA
formal_object: Centered paired training covariance Q,C and cross-covariance S; Q+rho I,C+rho I SPD; a^T(Q+rho I)a=b^T(C+rho I)b=1.
assumptions: Only released fitting positive pairs determine means/covariances.
Centering and ridge are frozen at evaluation; no test fitting.
Regularized correlation maximization is not a semantic relevance guarantee.

operations.output: Top singular pairs of A_q S A_c solve the correlation problem.

derivation_steps.statement: u=(Q+rho I)^1/2 a, v=(C+rho I)^1/2 b transform constraints to unit lengths.
derivation_steps.justification: Invertible change of coordinates preserves the specified regularized feasible set.

derivation_steps.statement: max u^T A_q S A_c v is its largest singular value; k orthonormal pairs use top-k SVD.
derivation_steps.justification: Standard singular-value variational characterization, applied after both whitenings.

derivation_steps.statement: z_q=(q-mq)A_q U_k, z_c=(c-mc)A_c V_k; rank by z_q z_c^T.
derivation_steps.justification: Legacy two-view scoring uses the transformed dot product without per-point renormalization. A shared signal assumption is additional, not implied by the SVD.

method_expression: Fit paired two-view mean/covariance transforms and top-k cross-SVD on training positives, then apply fixed maps to every evaluation input.
distinguishing_prediction: Only training cross-correlated directions are emphasized; uncorrelated but useful complementary semantics can be discarded.
falsifier: Whitening or Procrustes with the same information/rank reaches the same native outcome, or domain-shifted correlations harm retrieval.
closest_alternative: Classical regularized CCA, orthogonal Procrustes and same-rank unconstrained two-view least squares; no new CCA theorem or algorithm.
decisive_comparison: Full native image tasks with same training/PCA/rank and matched white/Procrustes controls; native labels/candidate lists untouched.
legacy_code_audit: Legacy fit(I10) uses centered train positives and a whitened cross-SVD; no matched Procrustes control or new Local software evidence.
review_limit: Linear algebra reviewed conditionally; closest modern functional audit and natural task value pending.
